knownTraps: PowerShell environment references are $env:NAME. A backslash before the colon, such as $env\:TEMP, is command corruption and must fail validation.
Do not paste prompt markers, PS C:\ prompts, continuation prompts, transcript decorations, or escaped URL punctuation into operator commands.

A top-level exit in an interactive PowerShell command can close the operator terminal and destroy visible diagnostics. Run exit-propagating work in a child process and print the captured exit code in the parent shell.
Remote GitHub content must not be treated as present merely because a commit or PR was reported. Resolve the ref and the exact file through a read request before handing off the command.
For gh api content retrieval with parameters, use an explicit GET request and field argument instead of depending on an interpolated query string.
Generated runtime evidence remains outside the repository and must not be committed.
Static command validation proves transport integrity only; it does not prove the target runtime, GUI visibility, tmux attachment, provider authentication, or operator acceptance.
proofCeiling: Tracked command-delivery contracts, deterministic corruption detection, source-resolution requirements, safe interactive-shell semantics, and CI validation. Live operator execution remains separate runtime proof.
